test_title: PYST 2: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

In today’s world, technology __must be used for feed__ the changing forces in society.

options.text: must had been used to feed
must have been used to feed

solution:
The correct answer is: **must be used to feed**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence contains a grammatical error in the use of the preposition "**for**" after "<s
